sources.title: My Document - universal-robots.com
sources.snippet: The UR5e brings ultimate flexibility to medium-duty applications with a payload of up to 5 kg and a reach of 850 mm. Today, more than 100,000 UR collaborative industrial robots have been delivered to customers across industries and around the world. The e-Series of cobots brings incredible flexibility and unparalleled ease of use to your application.
